newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha slips as crude falls, spreads narrow.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha slips as crude falls, spreads narrow.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices erased their gains to end about $1.50 lower for prompt supplies after crude and gasoline turned sharply lower on Thursday.

Physical trade was lacklustre and some traders said petrochemical demand may cushion further declines as naphtha remains a favourable feedstock. But end user demand was not expected to be robust until mid-month.

One trader said Nov/Dec swaps narrowed about $1 to a $4.50 backwardation due to perceptions of adequate near term supply. Early 1997 swaps prices were hit by sellers taking advantage of richer crack spreads, he said.
